summary: Map the host operating system to Node's os.platform vocabulary rather than .NET platform names.

semantics.return_values: Node platform identifiers such as win32, linux, darwin, aix, freebsd, openbsd, sunos; android may appear on experimental builds
semantics.equivalent_surface: matches process.platform for the same Node-compatible host

caveats: OperatingSystem/RuntimeInformation names are not directly the same strings.

tests.name: edge Windows spelling
tests.expected_behavior: on Windows returns true; Node does not return 'windows'
